description: A saved voice of your organization ("My voices") that can be applied to the speaker of a recording.

id.description: Voice ID. Use it as `voiceId` when assigning the voice to a speaker. A voice with `source` `external` comes from the ElevenLabs account your organization connected: its ID is the ElevenLabs voice ID, not a UUID, and it can be listed and assigned to a speaker but not fetched, renamed or deleted here.

projectId.description: Project the voice was made from, if any.

source.description: How the voice was made, for example from an upload or from a recording.

previewUrl.description: Short link to a sample of the voice.
